GONE FISHING - MANUAL INSTALL WITH PORTMASTER ON NEXTUI
=======================================================

Tested on the TrimUI Brick with NextUI. Gone Fishing should work on any device
that runs PortMaster; on other systems, copy "Gone Fishing.sh" and the
"gonefishing" folder into your usual PortMaster ports folder.

By SkyWalker541 - https://github.com/SkyWalker541/Gone-Fishing

You need:
  - Your SD card and a computer
  - gonefishing.zip from the latest release:
    https://github.com/SkyWalker541/Gone-Fishing/releases/latest


1. INSTALL PORTMASTER (skip this if you already have it)
   - On the device, open the Pak Store and install PortMaster ("PORTS").
   - Or by hand: download PORTS.pakz from github.com/ben16w/minui-portmaster,
     copy it to the root of the SD card, then eject the card and restart the
     device. NextUI installs it by itself.
   - Open "Ports" once on the device so PortMaster can finish setting up.

2. UNZIP THE GAME ON YOUR COMPUTER
   Unzip gonefishing.zip. You get two things:
     Gone Fishing.sh     (the launcher)
     gonefishing         (a folder with the game inside)

3. COPY THEM TO THE SD CARD
   Put the SD card in your computer and copy:

     Gone Fishing.sh  ->  /Roms/Ports (PORTS)/
     gonefishing      ->  /Roms/Ports (PORTS)/.ports/

   So you end up with:
     /Roms/Ports (PORTS)/Gone Fishing.sh
     /Roms/Ports (PORTS)/.ports/gonefishing/gonefishing.love   (and the rest)

   Note: ".ports" starts with a dot, so it is a hidden folder.
     - Mac: in Finder press Cmd + Shift + . (period) to show hidden folders.
     - Windows: in File Explorer, View > Show > Hidden items.
   If the .ports folder isn't there yet, create it.

4. PLAY
   Eject the SD card, put it back in the device, open Ports, and pick
   "Gone Fishing".

   Saves are kept in the gonefishing/saves folder.


CONTROLS
  D-pad Left/Right  Row the boat (or drive with a trolling motor)
  A                 Hold to cast, hold to reel, press to strike
  Down / Up         Let line out / reel in
  B                 Reel fast / release a catch / back
  X                 Pet your dog or cat
  Y                 Trolling menu (needs the Auto Trolling Motor)
  Start             Tackle box (shop, gear, look, map, settings...)
  L / R             Change tackle box sections

  You can remap A, B, X, Y and Start in Settings > Controls.


UPDATING
  Copy the new "Gone Fishing.sh" and "gonefishing" folder over the old ones.
  Keep the gonefishing/saves folder so you don't lose your progress.

IF IT DOESN'T SHOW UP OR START
  - Check that the folder names match exactly, including "Ports (PORTS)"
    and ".ports".
  - Make sure you copied the "gonefishing" folder itself, not just what's
    inside it.
  - The PortMaster log is in /.userdata/tg5040/logs/PORTS.txt

UPDATES
  Improvements may be released. Check back for updates at:
  https://github.com/SkyWalker541/Gone-Fishing/releases
